acceptance_rule: numerically_equivalent requires zero mismatches, exact schemas/counts/discrete and state arrays, and every admitted float difference inside its predeclared inclusive absolute-or-relative and optional ULP bounds
exact_fields: expected/master row equals expected instrumented JSON
run schema and all scientific fields except avg_energy_j_per_task
per-step schema, dtype, shape, and every array except lat_sum
VEC-07 request identity, output hashes, source/input immutability, and engine labels

excluded_fields.run.actor basename: the isolated runner stages the exact actor blob as actor.npz; semantic identity is verified from the receipt and hash
excluded_fields.run.wall_s: machine-dependent performance metadata, never a scientific endpoint

interpretation_limits: one protocol-seed weekend case does not establish cross-platform or scenario-wide equivalence
wall-clock performance is excluded and no speed claim is admitted
per-task expected values are unavailable for this case
VEC-08 reproduction does not itself expose a product direct-launch control

per-step.lat_sum.rationale: Frozen after the first controlled Apple-arm64 CPU calibration: 9,536 of 32,400 float32 per-step latency sums differed by at most 0.00390625 ms and three ULPs while every discrete/state stream and the final latency aggregate matched exactly.

run.avg_energy_j_per_task.rationale: Frozen after the first controlled Apple-arm64 CPU calibration: the only scalar drift was a 6.04e-8 energy reduction difference; the bound covers float32 reduction order without covering any task, action, deadline, latency, or fleet-count change.

unavailable_comparisons.per-task expected artifact: the source package has no per-task file for this approved weekend case; the observed file is schema-validated by VEC-07 but not compared numerically
